inputs.original_text: Health workers took to the streets at Unity Fountain in Maitama on Thursday because the reform bills before the National Assembly are not just routine changes. The people pushing them seem to be using “reform” as cover to reshape the health sector from the top down, while those who know how the system works are left to bear the consequences. When workers from the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations are both protesting, that’s a warning sign—not something to brush off as noise.
inputs.modified_text: The protest at Unity Fountain in Maitama on Thursday looks like a warning that the National Assembly’s “reform” bills are a power grab dressed up as routine change. When both the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations are raising the alarm, it’s hard to believe this is just noise. The people pushing these bills appear intent on reshaping the health sector while making workers and the public absorb the consequences.
